descriptionMarkdown:
Rest Duration Effect
Short Rest At least 1 hour
A period of relative safety with no strenuous activity. You may spend Hit Dice; for each 
die spent, roll it and regain HP equal to the result + your Constitution modifier. Recover 
features that say they return on a short rest. Warp Pressure is reduced to 0 as described 
in Chapter 15.
Long Rest At least 8 hours
At least 6 hours should be sleep or an equivalent species-appropriate rest unless the 
GM rules otherwise. Restore all lost HP, recover long-rest features and regain spent Hit 
Dice up to half your total Hit Dice, minimum one. Warp Pressure is reduced to 0. A 
character can normally benefit from only one long rest in 24 hours.
Rest does not remove Corruption, lasting injuries, lost equipment or narrative consequences unless a specific rule says 
otherwise.
